course_review/1.summary: 17 of 18 holes OK (holes 7 and 11 have small doubts). Hole 15 Black tee is wrong (walk-back in the trees); move it to the OSM back box (~399 yds). Pars and yardages match the card on every other hole. Publishable after the hole-15 fix; as-is the hole-15 Black advice is from an imaginary tee.
